{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-check the filtered data: only completed, non-refunded, non-QA, non-missing age
filtered_data = data[
    (data['status'] == 'completed') &
    (data['revenue'] != 999999.99) &
    (data['customer_age'] != -1)
]

# Confirm the population
print(f"Final population size: {len(filtered_data)}")

# Now compute overall average revenue per converted order for each channel
# Only consider converted orders (converted == 1)
converted_orders = filtered_data[filtered_data['converted'] == 1]

# Group by channel and compute mean revenue
overall_avg_revenue = converted_orders.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
print(overall_avg_revenue)

# Also print counts per channel to check balance
channel_counts = converted_orders.groupby('channel').size()
print(channel_counts)"}
